Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of Acer Nitro V 15 (ANV15-51) RTX 2050?

The Acer Nitro V 15 (ANV15-51) RTX 2050 features a 65W TGP rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 4GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 NVMe PCIe slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

Acer Nitro V 15 (ANV15-51) RTX 2050 scores 9.0/10 for software engineering. Its Intel Core i5-13420H (8 Cores: 4P + 4E, 12 Threads, up to 4.6 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
